The '''twisted bow''' is a rare reward from the [[Chambers of Xeric]] that requires a [[Ranged]] level of 85 to wield. It can fire any type of arrow, including [[dragon arrow]]s. The twisted bow is extremely valuable due to its unmatched power against monsters with a high Magic level or accuracy bonus, such as [[Commander Zilyana]] and [[TzKal-Zuk]].

Similar to the [[crystal bow]], the bow has an [[attack range]] of 10 tiles. As all attacks have a maximum of 10 range, [[Combat Options|longrange]] does not provide any attack distance benefit but may still be used to gain [[Defence]] XP.

==Passive effect==
<!--[[File:Chambers of Xeric (10).png|thumb|350px|A graph that shows the accuracy and damage modifiers at different Magic levels. Note that the "buff %" is not an {{wp|Percentage#Percentage_increase_and_decrease|increase}}: at 100%, the accuracy and damage are normal rather than doubled.]]-->
Unlike other bows that have a set strength, the twisted bow functions differently: the higher the target's [[Magic]] level or Magic accuracy is (whichever is higher), the higher the bow's accuracy and damage. The accuracy multiplier caps at 140% (reached at 244 magic level or accuracy), while the damage multiplier caps at 250% (never reached due to the scaling cap).{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Kieren|url=https://twitter.com/JagexKieren/status/869214311675285505|date=29 May 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/104081|archivedate=29 May 2020|quote=Outside raids, magic cap at 250 Acc modifier: 140 + (10 * 3 Magic / 10 - 10) / 100 - ((3 Magic / 10 - 100) ^2) / 100 Capped at 140.}}{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Kieren|url=https://twitter.com/JagexKieren/status/869214343283564544|date=29 May 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/103109|archivedate=29 May 2020|quote=Dmg modifier: 250 + (10 * 3 Magic / 10 - 14) / 100 - ((3 Magic / 10 - 140) ^2) / 100 Capped at 250.}} The Magic level or magic accuracy bonus caps at 250 outside the [[Chambers of Xeric]], and 350 within.

<math>\begin{align}
\text{Accuracy} &= 140 + \frac{\frac{10 \times 3 \times \text{Magic}}{10} - 10}{100} - \frac{\left(\frac{3 \times \text{Magic}}{10} - 100\right)^2}{100} \% & \text{Accuracy} \in [0, 140]\\
\text{Damage} &= 250 + \frac{\frac{10 \times 3 \times \text{Magic}}{10} - 14}{100} - \frac{\left(\frac{3 \times \text{Magic}}{10} - 140\right)^2}{100} \% & \text{Damage} \in [0, 250]
\end{align}</math>

Assuming [[dragon arrow]]s, 99 [[Ranged]], and all damage boosting items and effects, the maximum hit with the twisted bow outside of the [[Chambers of Xeric]], [[Tombs of Amascut]], or [[Nightmare Zone]] is 92 (94 on accurate) on a Slayer task and 88 (90 on accurate) off-task. The absolute max hit possible currently is 109 (111 on accurate), which is possible while attacking a boss inside Chambers of Xeric with 350 magic or higher, while under the influence of an [[Overload (+)]].

{{Subject changes header}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 11 May 2022
|update = Equipment Rebalance Tier Changes & Poll 76
|change = The twisted bow now requires level 85 Ranged to wield instead of level 75 Ranged.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 21 April 2021
|update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One
|change = The twisted bow's prayer bonus has been reduced from 4 to 0.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 9 August 2018
|update = Looting Bag Improvements, PID Changes and Bounty Hunter Targets
|change = The item's value was increased from 90,000 to 4,000,000.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 12 April 2018
|update = Quality of Life Improvements
|change = A Magic level cap of 350 was added within the [[Chambers of Xeric]], as the twisted bow performed worse if monsters had a Magic level of over 350, due to the equations acting as {{wp|parabola}}s.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 1 June 2017
|update = The Inferno
|change = Attempting to use a Twisted Bow for Barbarian Firemaking will now display a message to explain you can't.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 26 January 2017
|update = Prayers Scrolls, QoL & a Quest
|change = The Magic level cap was removed within the Chambers of Xeric.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 19 January 2017
|update = Raids Tweaks & QoL
|change = A Magic level cap of 250 was added to the damage calculation, as it was too powerful against some bosses.
}}
